shadows.name: --cds-panel-shadow
shadows.light: 0 0 0 1px hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 10%), 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)
shadows.dark: 0 0 0 1px hsl(from #fff h s l / 10%), 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 #0000003d

shadows.name: --cds-shadow-lg
shadows.light: 0 4px 8px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%), 0 12px 28px -2px hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)

shadows.name: --cds-shadow-md
shadows.light: 0 2px 4px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 7%), 0 6px 16px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)

shadows.name: --cds-shadow-sm
shadows.light: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 6%), 0 2px 8px 0 hsl(from #0b0b0b h s l / 8%)
